name: Layered Volume Rendering with Light Propagation
definition: A compute-shader-based volume rendering technique that processes a stack of parallel planes (layers). It propagates light and view rays across layers, accumulating color, alpha, and material properties while applying refraction gradients and transfer functions.
summary: Layered Volume Rendering with Light Propagation is a compute-shader technique that decouples light transport from view ray accumulation across parallel planes to efficiently approximate scattering and refraction.
